dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Vanilla Froyo is at risk due to his behavior concerns. In the care center Vanilla Froyo has shown fearfulness such as a lowered and tense body , trembling, difficulty engaging with handlers, and inconsistent reactions to people and environmental stimuli, including lunging toward a passing bicyclist. He has also thrashed when being removed from his kennel, head-whipped when handling was attempted, and has been observed biting the kennel bars hard enough to break them. He will solicits brief petting from handlers. Medically, Vanilla Froyo has Alopecia and CIRDC.

Vanilla arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to have a tense body, pinned back ears, and began seeking exit. During intake, Vanilla was noted to hard stare and growl at handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Vanilla Froyo
